complexity.notes: Setting sys.setrecursionlimit(2**29) is a hack to survive deep (skewed) trees; it risks crashing the C stack for pathological depths, so an explicit iterative stack would be more robust. The conditional only triggers on the outermost call, which is fine since the default argument is -inf only there.
complexity.summary: Recursive DFS that threads the maximum value seen on the root-to-current path, counting a node as good when its value meets or exceeds that running maximum.
